request.raw_text: Make the part symmetrical with respect to ZX plane by adding lowered plateau to the bottom. Then add embossed text to the top to distinguish the top (text should be "TOP", Arial, 10mm height, 1mm raised above lowered plateau, not sticking out of the plateau, approximately centered to the middle).
parameter_words: not sticking out of the plateau

aim.primary_aim: Provide ZX-plane symmetry for the underlying plateau geometry by adding a bottom lowered plateau, while identifying the top with contained, approximately centered raised text.

functional_design_intentions.name: Top identification
functional_design_intentions.description: Enable the top of the part to be distinguished by an embossed "TOP" marking.

targets_to_change.reference_geometry: lowered plateau on the bottom of the part
embossed text on the top lowered plateau

targets_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Preserve existing geometry except for the added bottom lowered plateau and the added top embossed text; preserve the top plateau boundary while keeping the text within it.

geometry.description: A lowered plateau exists on the bottom and makes the underlying plateau geometry symmetric with respect to the ZX plane.
Raised Arial text reading "TOP" exists on the top lowered plateau, has 10 mm text height, rises 1 mm above the plateau, remains within the plateau boundary, and is approximately centered.

functions.name: Identify top
functions.description: The embossed "TOP" marking distinguishes the top of the part.

behaviors.name: Visible raised indication
behaviors.description: The raised text provides a visible and physically raised indication of the part's top side.

validation_criteria.description: A lowered plateau is present on the bottom and the underlying plateau geometry is symmetric with respect to the ZX plane.
The embossed text content is exactly "TOP".
The text is raised 1 mm above the lowered plateau.
The text is approximately centered on the middle of the top plateau.
The text does not extend outside the plateau boundary.
The marking clearly distinguishes the top of the part.
The top indication is visible and raised relative to the lowered plateau.
Non-targeted geometry remains unchanged apart from the bottom plateau addition and top embossed text.

unresolved_requirements.description: No independent dimensions or profile are supplied for the new bottom lowered plateau.
candidate_interpretations: Derive its geometry from the corresponding opposite-side plateau so that the underlying part geometry is symmetric about the ZX plane.
Use separately specified plateau dimensions, which are absent from the request.

unresolved_requirements.description: The request first requires symmetry about the ZX plane and then adds text only to the top, so literal symmetry of all final geometry would be broken by the identifying text.
candidate_interpretations: Apply symmetry to the underlying part and plateau geometry, with the top-only text intentionally excluded from the symmetry requirement.
Apply symmetry to all final geometry, which would require corresponding bottom text and conflict with the stated top-identification intent.

unresolved_requirements.description: The exact reference for "approximately centered to the middle" is not formally specified.
candidate_interpretations: Center the text approximately within the top lowered plateau.
Center the text approximately within the overall top of the part.

unresolved_requirements.description: The phrase "not sticking out of the plateau" does not explicitly state whether it refers only to the text footprint or also to another geometric limit.
candidate_interpretations: Keep the complete text footprint within the plateau boundary while allowing the specified 1 mm raised height.
Apply an additional unspecified limit to the text beyond the plateau containment and raised-height requirements.
